notes: Of the two δέ tokens in the list, the ASV writes only one and (t011); it is given to the δέ of the third member it introduces, leaving s010 unrepresented.
The italicized say is added under rule 103 rather than folded onto εἶπαν, a full lexical verb not being on rule 7's list of helpers; the rule 15 reading is conceded in the unit note.
Οἱ μέν gives Some to the correlative article and leaves μέν unrepresented, which is what rule 70 states in terms.
